data.name: Sitry Spirit at Dusk
data.detailed_description:
• Wake up on an unknown planet

You open your eyes in a world you don’t recognize.

You don’t know why you’re here or what you’re supposed to do.
But one thing is crystal clear.
You have to survive.

  • Survive and adapt

This strange planet is beautiful, but it’s also full of danger.
Explore your surroundings, gather whatever resources you can find, and pick up what’s been left behind.
Craft tools, build shelters, and create the structures you need to stay alive.
Make yourself a safe home, and learn how to endure in this harsh environment.

  • Uncover the hidden story

Scattered logs and forgotten records are waiting to be found.
Piece them together and discover why you woke up here, and what secrets this planet is hiding.
The deeper you explore, the more mysteries and clues you’ll uncover.

  • Your journey is in your hands

Explore, craft, and survive.
It’s up to you how you use your resources, what kind of home you build, and which path you decide to take.
This world is dangerous, yes but it’s also filled with endless possibilities.

So, what will you do?
Will you survive until the very end?

data.short_description: You wake up on a strange planet with no memory of why you’re here. To survive, you’ll need to gather resources, craft tools, and build a home. Search for clues and uncover the truth of this mysterious world. The question is… can you make it out alive?
